title: Mount Athos dedicated to Mary and closed to women
summary: Ralph tells of Mount Athos dedicated to Mary and closed to women, about to this day at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: women to this day cannot go on Mount Athos, step foot on Mount Athos, because it's dedicated completely to Mary at the exclusion of all women.

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, a man named Ralph who speaks as a witness, says that to this day women cannot set foot on Mount Athos, a mountain in Greece. He says this is because the mountain is dedicated entirely to Mary, the mother of Jesus, and women are excluded. He brings it up as part of a wider discussion of sacred and ancient oracle sites in Greece.
